description: Plot a prose intensity curve per sentence and flag where a tense passage loses velocity — Scores each sentence of narrative prose for pace from sentence length, share of one-syllable words, exclamation and question marks and, if you supply a word list, action-word share; smooths the scores into an intensity curve; and reports stalls, the spans where intensity falls well below an earlier peak. For a writing tool or editor agent checking an action or tension scene. A fixed-weight heurist

actionWords.description: Your own action-word list. Without it the action component is left out and the other weights are renormalized.

expect.description: tense: fail if the curve never reaches peakThreshold. any (default): only stalls after a peak can fail.

minSentences.description: Fewer scored sentences is unknown. Default 8.

peakThreshold.description: Smoothed intensity a passage must reach before a later fall can be a stall. Default 0.55.

stallDrop.description: Fall below the running peak that counts as a stall. Default 0.25 on the 0-1 intensity scale.

window.description: Sentences in the trailing moving average. Default 3.

name: pacing-intensity-evaluator
